# Specialize.ps1 (Windows 11 24H2/25H2) - roda como SYSTEM durante a instalacao # Log: C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\Specialize.log $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# ==================== CONFIGURACAO ==================== $DesligarDefender = $true # $false = Defender ligado (aplicado no primeiro login) $ModoUpdate = 'avisar' # 'avisar' = so baixa e instala quando voce clicar (padrao) # 'seguranca' = baixa sozinho, so instala/reinicia quando voce mandar # 'manual' = Windows Update automatico totalmente desligado $VersaoTravada = '25H2' # nao pula para a proxima versao do Windows sem voce querer $BarraEsquerda = $true # $false = icones da barra de tarefas centralizados $DesligarVBS = $true # desliga Isolamento de Nucleo/VBS (aplicado no primeiro login) # ======================================================
Start-Transcript -Path 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\Specialize.log' -Force | Out-Null function RegSet($path, $name, $type, $value) { & reg.exe add $path /v $name /t $type /d $value /f | Out-Null }
# --------------------------------------------------------------- # 0) Usuario local "Player" (sem senha, administrador). O grupo e localizado pelo # SID S-1-5-32-544, entao funciona em pt-BR ("Administradores") ou en-US. # --------------------------------------------------------------- $usuario = 'Player' if (-not (Get-LocalUser -Name $usuario -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { & net.exe user $usuario /add /fullname:$usuario | Out-Null } Set-LocalUser -Name $usuario -PasswordNeverExpires $true -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $admins = (Get-LocalGroup -SID 'S-1-5-32-544').Name & net.exe localgroup $admins $usuario /add 2>$null | Out-Null & net.exe accounts /maxpwage:unlimited | Out-Null Write-Host "Usuario $usuario no grupo $admins"
# --------------------------------------------------------------- # 1) Apps provisionados - lista NEGRA. Mantidos: Store, Calculadora, Fotos, # Ferramenta de Captura, Paint, Terminal, winget, codecs, # frameworks e paineis de driver (NVIDIA/AMD/Realtek). # --------------------------------------------------------------- $remover = @( 'Clipchamp.Clipchamp' 'Microsoft.549981C3F5F10' # Cortana 'Microsoft.BingNews' 'Microsoft.BingSearch' 'Microsoft.BingWeather' 'Microsoft.Copilot' 'Microsoft.GamingApp' # app Xbox 'Microsoft.GetHelp' 'Microsoft.Getstarted' # Dicas 'Microsoft.MicrosoftOfficeHub' 'Microsoft.MicrosoftSolitaireCollection' 'Microsoft.MicrosoftStickyNotes' 'Microsoft.OutlookForWindows' 'Microsoft.People' 'Microsoft.PowerAutomateDesktop' 'Microsoft.Todos' 'Microsoft.Windows.DevHome' 'Microsoft.WindowsAlarms' 'Microsoft.WindowsCamera' 'microsoft.windowscommunicationsapps' 'Microsoft.WindowsFeedbackHub' 'Microsoft.WindowsMaps' 'Microsoft.WindowsSoundRecorder' 'Microsoft.Xbox.TCUI' 'Microsoft.XboxApp' 'Microsoft.XboxGameOverlay' 'Microsoft.XboxGamingOverlay' # Xbox Game Bar 'Microsoft.XboxIdentityProvider' 'Microsoft.XboxSpeechToTextOverlay' 'Microsoft.YourPhone' # Link to Phone 'Microsoft.ZuneMusic' # Media Player 'Microsoft.ZuneVideo' # Filmes e TV 'Microsoft.WindowsNotepad' # Bloco de Notas (substituido pelo Notepad++) 'MicrosoftCorporationII.MicrosoftFamily' 'MicrosoftCorporationII.QuickAssist' 'MicrosoftTeams' 'MSTeams' ) Get-AppxProvisionedPackage -Online | Where-Object { $remover -contains $_.DisplayName } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "Removendo app: $($_.DisplayName)" Remove-AppxProvisionedPackage -Online -PackageName $_.PackageName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }
# --------------------------------------------------------------- # 2) Recursos opcionais inuteis + Recall # --------------------------------------------------------------- $caps = @('Browser.InternetExplorer', 'MathRecognizer', 'Hello.Face', 'App.Support.QuickAssist', 'App.StepsRecorder', 'Microsoft.Windows.WordPad', 'Print.Fax.Scan') Get-WindowsCapability -Online | Where-Object { $n = $_.Name; $_.State -eq 'Installed' -and ($caps | Where-Object { $n -like "$_*" }) } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "Removendo capability: $($_.Name)" Remove-WindowsCapability -Online -Name $_.Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }
# --------------------------------------------------------------- # 3) Servicos desativados. SysMain fica LIGADO (ajuda jogos no HD). # --------------------------------------------------------------- $servicos = @( 'DiagTrack', 'dmwappushservice', 'diagnosticshub.standardcollector.service', 'WerSvc', 'WSearch', 'MapsBroker', 'lfsvc', 'Fax', 'RetailDemo', 'WMPNetworkSvc', 'wisvc', 'XblAuthManager', 'XblGameSave', 'XboxNetApiSvc', 'PhoneSvc', 'icssvc', 'SEMgrSvc', 'WpcMonSvc', 'TrkWks', 'RemoteRegistry', 'Spooler', 'PrintNotify' ) foreach ($s in $servicos) { if (Get-Service -Name $s -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Host "Desativando servico: $s" RegSet "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\$s" 'Start' 'REG_DWORD' 4 } }
# --------------------------------------------------------------- # 6) Politicas: telemetria, propaganda, Copilot, Recall, Widgets, OneDrive... # --------------------------------------------------------------- $P = 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft' RegSet "$P\Windows\DataCollection" 'AllowTelemetry' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\Windows\DataCollection" 'DoNotShowFeedbackNotifications' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Windows\CloudContent" 'DisableConsumerFeatures' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Windows\CloudContent" 'DisableSoftLanding' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Windows\CloudContent" 'DisableCloudOptimizedContent' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Windows\Windows Search" 'AllowCortana' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\Windows\Windows Search" 'DisableWebSearch' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Windows\Windows Search" 'ConnectedSearchUseWeb' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\Windows\AdvertisingInfo" 'DisabledByGroupPolicy' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Windows\System" 'EnableActivityFeed' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\Windows\System" 'PublishUserActivities' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\Windows\System" 'UploadUserActivities' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\Windows\Windows Error Reporting" 'Disabled' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Windows\OneDrive" 'DisableFileSyncNGSC' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Windows\GameDVR" 'AllowGameDVR' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\Windows\DeliveryOptimization" 'DODownloadMode' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\Dsh" 'AllowNewsAndInterests' 'REG_DWORD' 0 # Widgets RegSet "$P\Windows\Windows Chat" 'ChatIcon' 'REG_DWORD' 3 # Chat/Teams RegSet "$P\Windows\WindowsCopilot" 'TurnOffWindowsCopilot' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Windows\WindowsAI" 'DisableAIDataAnalysis' 'REG_DWORD' 1 # Recall RegSet "$P\Windows\WindowsAI" 'AllowRecallEnablement' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\Windows\WindowsAI" 'DisableClickToDo' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Edge" 'StartupBoostEnabled' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\Edge" 'BackgroundModeEnabled' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\Edge" 'HideFirstRunExperience' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Edge" 'HubsSidebarEnabled' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\OOBE' 'BypassNRO' 'REG_DWORD' 1
# Windows Update: nunca reinicia sozinho, nunca troca driver de video, # e fica na versao escolhida (sem "atualizacao de recursos" surpresa). if ($ModoUpdate -eq 'manual') { RegSet "$P\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU" 'NoAutoUpdate' 'REG_DWORD' 1 } elseif ($ModoUpdate -eq 'seguranca') { RegSet "$P\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU" 'NoAutoUpdate' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU" 'AUOptions' 'REG_DWORD' 3 } else { RegSet "$P\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU" 'NoAutoUpdate' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU" 'AUOptions' 'REG_DWORD' 2 # avisa antes de baixar } RegSet "$P\Windows\WindowsUpdate" 'SetUpdateNotificationLevel' 'REG_DWORD' 1 # so avisos de reinicio RegSet "$P\Windows\WindowsUpdate" 'UpdateNotificationLevel' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU" 'NoAutoRebootWithLoggedOnUsers' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Windows\WindowsUpdate" 'ExcludeWUDriversInQualityUpdate' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Windows\WindowsUpdate" 'TargetReleaseVersion' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Windows\WindowsUpdate" 'ProductVersion' 'REG_SZ' 'Windows 11' RegSet "$P\Windows\WindowsUpdate" 'TargetReleaseVersionInfo' 'REG_SZ' $VersaoTravada RegSet 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\DriverSearching' 'SearchOrderConfig' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\WindowsStore" 'AutoDownload' 'REG_DWORD' 2
# --------------------------------------------------------------- # 6b) Pacote de privacidade (GPEDIT do ET) + extras # --------------------------------------------------------------- RegSet "$P\Windows\AppCompat" 'AITEnable' 'REG_DWORD' 0 # telemetria de compatibilidade RegSet "$P\Windows\AppCompat" 'DisableInventory' 'REG_DWORD' 1 # coletor de inventario RegSet "$P\Windows\AppCompat" 'DisableUAR' 'REG_DWORD' 1 # gravador de passos RegSet "$P\Speech" 'AllowSpeechModelUpdate' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\PushToInstall" 'DisablePushToInstall' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Windows\LocationAndSensors" 'DisableWindowsLocationProvider' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\FindMyDevice" 'AllowFindMyDevice' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\Windows\Windows Search" 'AllowSearchToUseLocation' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\Windows\Windows Search" 'AllowCloudSearch' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\Windows\Windows Search" 'EnableDynamicContentInWSB' 'REG_DWORD' 0 # destaques da pesquisa RegSet "$P\Windows\Windows Search" 'ConnectedSearchPrivacy' 'REG_DWORD' 3 RegSet "$P\Windows\SettingSync" 'DisableSettingSync' 'REG_DWORD' 2 RegSet "$P\Windows\SettingSync" 'DisableSettingSyncUserOverride' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Windows\System" 'AllowCrossDeviceClipboard' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$P\Dsh" 'DisableWidgetsOnLockScreen' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Dsh" 'DisableWidgetsBoard' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Windows\WindowsAI" 'DisableSettingsAgent' 'REG_DWORD' 1 # pesquisa por IA nas Configuracoes RegSet "$P\Windows\AppPrivacy" 'LetAppsAccessMotion' 'REG_DWORD' 2 RegSet "$P\Windows\Windows Error Reporting" 'LoggingDisabled' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$P\Windows\Explorer" 'DisableGraphRecentItems' 'REG_DWORD' 1 # sem "insights"/recomendados no Explorer RegSet 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' 'NoRecentDocsHistory' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet 'HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\BitLocker' 'PreventDeviceEncryption' 'REG_DWORD' 1 # sem criptografia automatica RegSet 'HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem' 'LongPathsEnabled' 'REG_DWORD' 1
# --------------------------------------------------------------- # 7) Desempenho / jogos # --------------------------------------------------------------- $MM = 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile' RegSet $MM 'SystemResponsiveness' 'REG_DWORD' 10 RegSet $MM 'NetworkThrottlingIndex' 'REG_DWORD' '0xffffffff' RegSet "$MM\Tasks\Games" 'GPU Priority' 'REG_DWORD' 8 RegSet "$MM\Tasks\Games" 'Priority' 'REG_DWORD' 6 RegSet "$MM\Tasks\Games" 'Scheduling Category' 'REG_SZ' 'High' RegSet "$MM\Tasks\Games" 'SFIO Priority' 'REG_SZ' 'High' RegSet 'HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers' 'HwSchMode' 'REG_DWORD' 2 # HAGS ligado RegSet 'HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\PowerThrottling' 'PowerThrottlingOff' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet 'HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Power' 'HiberbootEnabled' 'REG_DWORD' 0 & fsutil.exe behavior set disablelastaccess 1 | Out-Null
# --------------------------------------------------------------- # 8) Tarefas agendadas de telemetria # --------------------------------------------------------------- $tarefas = @( '\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser' '\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser Exp' '\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\ProgramDataUpdater' '\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\StartupAppTask' '\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\MareBackup' '\Microsoft\Windows\Autochk\Proxy' '\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\Consolidator' '\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\UsbCeip' '\Microsoft\Windows\DiskDiagnostic\Microsoft-Windows-DiskDiagnosticDataCollector' '\Microsoft\Windows\Feedback\Siuf\DmClient' '\Microsoft\Windows\Feedback\Siuf\DmClientOnScenarioDownload' '\Microsoft\Windows\Maps\MapsUpdateTask' '\Microsoft\Windows\Maps\MapsToastTask' '\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting\QueueReporting' ) if ($DesligarDefender) { $tarefas += '\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Defender\Windows Defender Scheduled Scan', '\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Defender\Windows Defender Cache Maintenance', '\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Defender\Windows Defender Cleanup', '\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Defender\Windows Defender Verification' } foreach ($t in $tarefas) { & schtasks.exe /Change /TN $t /Disable 2>$null | Out-Null }
# --------------------------------------------------------------- # 9) Wallpaper e tela de bloqueio # --------------------------------------------------------------- $wpDir = 'C:\Windows\Web\Wallpaper\Custom' $wp = "$wpDir\wallpaper.jpg" New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $wpDir -Force | Out-Null Copy-Item 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\wallpaper.jpg' $wp -Force $CSP = 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\PersonalizationCSP' RegSet $CSP 'LockScreenImagePath' 'REG_SZ' $wp RegSet $CSP 'LockScreenImageUrl' 'REG_SZ' $wp RegSet $CSP 'LockScreenImageStatus' 'REG_DWORD' 1
# --------------------------------------------------------------- # 10) Perfil padrao (vale para o usuario que sera criado) # --------------------------------------------------------------- & reg.exe load 'HKU\DefUser' 'C:\Users\Default\NTUSER.DAT' | Out-Null $H = 'HKU\DefUser' $U = "$H\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion"
# Tema CLARO + wallpaper RegSet "$U\Themes\Personalize" 'AppsUseLightTheme' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$U\Themes\Personalize" 'SystemUsesLightTheme' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$U\Themes\Personalize" 'EnableTransparency' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$U\Themes\Personalize" 'ColorPrevalence' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$H\Control Panel\Desktop" 'Wallpaper' 'REG_SZ' $wp RegSet "$H\Control Panel\Desktop" 'WallpaperStyle' 'REG_SZ' '10' # Preencher RegSet "$H\Control Panel\Desktop" 'TileWallpaper' 'REG_SZ' '0' RegSet "$H\Control Panel\Desktop" 'JPEGImportQuality' 'REG_DWORD' 100 # sem recompressao RegSet "$H\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent" 'DisableSpotlightCollectionOnDesktop' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$U\ContentDeliveryManager" 'RotatingLockScreenEnabled' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$U\ContentDeliveryManager" 'RotatingLockScreenOverlayEnabled' 'REG_DWORD' 0
# Mouse cru (sem aceleracao) e sem teclas de aderencia RegSet "$H\Control Panel\Mouse" 'MouseSpeed' 'REG_SZ' '0' RegSet "$H\Control Panel\Mouse" 'MouseThreshold1' 'REG_SZ' '0' RegSet "$H\Control Panel\Mouse" 'MouseThreshold2' 'REG_SZ' '0' RegSet "$H\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys" 'Flags' 'REG_SZ' '506' RegSet "$H\Control Panel\Accessibility\ToggleKeys" 'Flags' 'REG_SZ' '58' RegSet "$H\Control Panel\Accessibility\Keyboard Response" 'Flags' 'REG_SZ' '122'
# Jogos: sem gravacao em segundo plano, Modo de Jogo ligado, # "otimizacoes para jogos em janela" ligada (menos latencia em janela sem borda) RegSet "$H\System\GameConfigStore" 'GameDVR_Enabled' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$U\GameDVR" 'AppCaptureEnabled' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$H\Software\Microsoft\GameBar" 'AutoGameModeEnabled' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$H\Software\Microsoft\GameBar" 'UseNexusForGameBarEnabled' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$H\Software\Microsoft\GameBar" 'ShowStartupPanel' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$H\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences" 'DirectXUserGlobalSettings' 'REG_SZ' 'SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=1;'
# Apps em segundo plano desligados RegSet "$U\BackgroundAccessApplications" 'GlobalUserDisabled' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$U\Search" 'BackgroundAppGlobalToggle' 'REG_DWORD' 0
# Sem sugestoes, apps instalados sozinhos, dicas, propaganda $CDM = "$U\ContentDeliveryManager" foreach ($v in 'ContentDeliveryAllowed', 'FeatureManagementEnabled', 'OemPreInstalledAppsEnabled', 'PreInstalledAppsEnabled', 'PreInstalledAppsEverEnabled', 'SilentInstalledAppsEnabled', 'SoftLandingEnabled', 'SystemPaneSuggestionsEnabled', 'SubscribedContent-310093Enabled', 'SubscribedContent-338387Enabled', 'SubscribedContent-338388Enabled', 'SubscribedContent-338389Enabled', 'SubscribedContent-338393Enabled', 'SubscribedContent-353694Enabled', 'SubscribedContent-353696Enabled', 'SubscribedContent-353698Enabled') { RegSet $CDM $v 'REG_DWORD' 0 } RegSet "$U\AdvertisingInfo" 'Enabled' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$U\Privacy" 'TailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticDataEnabled' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$H\Software\Microsoft\Siuf\Rules" 'NumberOfSIUFInPeriod' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$U\UserProfileEngagement" 'ScoobeSystemSettingEnabled' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet "$H\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer" 'DisableSearchBoxSuggestions' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$H\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot" 'TurnOffWindowsCopilot' 'REG_DWORD' 1
# Explorer / Iniciar / barra de tarefas $ADV = "$U\Explorer\Advanced" RegSet $ADV 'HideFileExt' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet $ADV 'LaunchTo' 'REG_DWORD' 1 # abre em "Este Computador" RegSet $ADV 'ShowTaskViewButton' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet $ADV 'TaskbarMn' 'REG_DWORD' 0 # Chat RegSet $ADV 'ShowCopilotButton' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet $ADV 'TaskbarAnimations' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet $ADV 'Start_TrackProgs' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet $ADV 'Start_TrackDocs' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet $ADV 'Start_IrisRecommendations' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet $ADV 'Start_AccountNotifications' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet $ADV 'Start_Layout' 'REG_DWORD' 1 # mais fixados, menos recomendados if ($BarraEsquerda) { RegSet $ADV 'TaskbarAl' 'REG_DWORD' 0 } RegSet "$U\Search" 'SearchboxTaskbarMode' 'REG_DWORD' 0 # pesquisa escondida (tecla Win continua buscando) RegSet $ADV 'Hidden' 'REG_DWORD' 1 # mostrar arquivos ocultos RegSet $ADV 'ShowSuperHidden' 'REG_DWORD' 0 # arquivos protegidos do sistema continuam ocultos RegSet "$ADV\TaskbarDeveloperSettings" 'TaskbarEndTask' 'REG_DWORD' 1 # "Finalizar tarefa" na barra # Menu de contexto classico (sem "Mostrar mais opcoes") & reg.exe add "$H\Software\Classes\CLSID\{86ca1aa0-34aa-4e8b-a509-50c905bae2a2}\InprocServer32" /ve /f | Out-Null
# Visual leve (fonte suavizada mantida) RegSet "$H\Control Panel\Desktop" 'MenuShowDelay' 'REG_SZ' '0' RegSet "$H\Control Panel\Desktop\WindowMetrics" 'MinAnimate' 'REG_SZ' '0' RegSet "$H\Software\Microsoft\Windows\DWM" 'EnableAeroPeek' 'REG_DWORD' 0
# OneDrive nunca e instalado para o usuario & reg.exe delete "$U\Run" /v OneDriveSetup /f 2>$null | Out-Null
[gc]::Collect(); Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) { & reg.exe unload 'HKU\DefUser' 2>$null | Out-Null if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { break } Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } # Passa as opcoes para o primeiro login "`$DesligarDefender = `$$DesligarDefender; `$DesligarVBS = `$$DesligarVBS" | Set-Content 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\Opcoes.ps1' -Encoding UTF8
# Barra de tarefas sem nenhum fixado (aplicado no primeiro login de cada usuario) $layoutDir = 'C:\Users\Default\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Windows\Shell' New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $layoutDir -Force | Out-Null @' <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <LayoutModificationTemplate xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/Start/2014/LayoutModification" xmlns:defaultlayout="http://schemas.microsoft.com/Start/2014/FullDefaultLayout" xmlns:start="http://schemas.microsoft.com/Start/2014/StartLayout" xmlns:taskbar="http://schemas.microsoft.com/Start/2014/TaskbarLayout" Version="1"> <CustomTaskbarLayoutCollection PinListPlacement="Replace"> <defaultlayout:TaskbarLayout> <taskbar:TaskbarPinList> <taskbar:DesktopApp DesktopApplicationLinkPath="#leaveempty" /> </taskbar:TaskbarPinList> </defaultlayout:TaskbarLayout> </CustomTaskbarLayoutCollection> </LayoutModificationTemplate> '@ | Set-Content -Path "$layoutDir\LayoutModification.xml" -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host 'Specialize concluido.' Stop-Transcript | Out-Null exit 0 # nunca devolve erro para o instalador

# Defender-Off.ps1 - desliga o Windows Defender via politicas. # Depois da instalacao, so funciona com a "Protecao contra adulteracao" DESLIGADA # (Seguranca do Windows > Protecao contra virus e ameacas > Gerenciar configuracoes). # Rode como administrador e reinicie. $D = 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender' function RegSet($path, $name, $value) { & reg.exe add $path /v $name /t REG_DWORD /d $value /f | Out-Null } RegSet $D 'DisableAntiSpyware' 1 RegSet $D 'DisableRoutinelyTakingAction' 1 RegSet $D 'ServiceKeepAlive' 0 RegSet "$D\Real-Time Protection" 'DisableRealtimeMonitoring' 1 RegSet "$D\Real-Time Protection" 'DisableBehaviorMonitoring' 1 RegSet "$D\Real-Time Protection" 'DisableOnAccessProtection' 1 RegSet "$D\Real-Time Protection" 'DisableScanOnRealtimeEnable' 1 RegSet "$D\Real-Time Protection" 'DisableIOAVProtection' 1 RegSet "$D\Spynet" 'SpynetReporting' 0 RegSet "$D\Spynet" 'SubmitSamplesConsent' 2 RegSet "$D\Reporting" 'DisableEnhancedNotifications' 1 RegSet 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender Security Center\Notifications' 'DisableNotifications' 1 RegSet 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System' 'EnableSmartScreen' 0 & reg.exe add 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer' /v SmartScreenEnabled /t REG_SZ /d Off /f | Out-Null try { Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true -ErrorAction Stop } catch { } Write-Host 'Politicas do Defender aplicadas. Reinicie o PC.'

# FirstLogon.ps1 (Windows 11) - roda uma vez no primeiro login # Log: C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\FirstLogon.log $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue' Start-Transcript -Path 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\FirstLogon.log' -Force | Out-Null
# ---- Opcoes vindas do Specialize (Defender / VBS / Recall) ---- $DesligarDefender = $true; $DesligarVBS = $true if (Test-Path 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\Opcoes.ps1') { . 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\Opcoes.ps1' } function RegSet($path, $name, $type, $value) { & reg.exe add $path /v $name /t $type /d $value /f | Out-Null }
if ($DesligarVBS) { RegSet 'HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard' 'EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet 'HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity' 'Enabled' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet 'HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa' 'LsaCfgFlags' 'REG_DWORD' 0 } if ($DesligarDefender) { & powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\Defender-Off.ps1' foreach ($t in 'Windows Defender Scheduled Scan', 'Windows Defender Cache Maintenance', 'Windows Defender Cleanup', 'Windows Defender Verification') { & schtasks.exe /Change /TN "\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Defender\$t" /Disable 2>$null | Out-Null } & reg.exe delete 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run' /v SecurityHealth /f 2>$null | Out-Null } Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName 'Recall' -NoRestart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
# Plano "Desempenho Maximo" (Ultimate) com GUID fixo e ATIVADO $ultimate = 'c5f2a0de-2b1d-4c3e-9a7f-000000000c52' & powercfg.exe -duplicatescheme e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb61 $ultimate | Out-Null & powercfg.exe -setactive $ultimate & powercfg.exe -change -monitor-timeout-ac 15 & powercfg.exe -change -standby-timeout-ac 0 & powercfg.exe -change -disk-timeout-ac 0
# Espaco no SSD & powercfg.exe -h off & dism.exe /Online /Set-ReservedStorageState /State:Disabled /Quiet Disable-ComputerRestore -Drive 'C:\' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue & vssadmin.exe delete shadows /for=C: /all /quiet 2>$null | Out-Null & net.exe accounts /maxpwage:unlimited | Out-Null
# Wallpaper (reforco: aplica direto, funciona mesmo com o Windows nao ativado) $wp = 'C:\Windows\Web\Wallpaper\Custom\wallpaper.jpg' Set-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name WallpaperStyle -Value '10' Set-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name TileWallpaper -Value '0' Add-Type -TypeDefinition @' using System.Runtime.InteropServices; public static class Wp { [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)] public static extern int SystemParametersInfo(int a, int b, string c, int d); } '@ [Wp]::SystemParametersInfo(20, 0, $wp, 3) | Out-Null # SPI_SETDESKWALLPAPER
# Atalho do Edge na area de trabalho Remove-Item "$env:PUBLIC\Desktop\Microsoft Edge.lnk", "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\Microsoft Edge.lnk" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# Apps que ainda tenham vindo para o usuario atual (inclui "sugeridos" da Microsoft) $remover = 'Clipchamp|BingNews|BingSearch|BingWeather|Microsoft\.Copilot|GamingApp|GetHelp|Getstarted|OfficeHub|SolitaireCollection|StickyNotes|OutlookForWindows|Microsoft\.People|PowerAutomate|Todos|DevHome|WindowsAlarms|WindowsCamera|communicationsapps|FeedbackHub|WindowsMaps|SoundRecorder|XboxApp|XboxGamingOverlay|XboxGameOverlay|XboxSpeechToText|Xbox\.TCUI|XboxIdentityProvider|YourPhone|ZuneMusic|ZuneVideo|MicrosoftFamily|QuickAssist|MSTeams|MicrosoftTeams|CandyCrush|Spotify|Disney|TikTok|Facebook|Instagram|LinkedIn|WindowsNotepad' Get-AppxPackage | Where-Object { $_.Name -match $remover -and -not $_.NonRemovable } | Remove-AppxPackage -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# ---- Ajustes do usuario (HKCU) ---- $ADV = 'HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' # Menu do botao direito classico (precisa ser aqui: a chave Classes so existe apos o 1o login) & reg.exe add 'HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{86ca1aa0-34aa-4e8b-a509-50c905bae2a2}\InprocServer32' /ve /f | Out-Null RegSet 'HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Search' 'SearchboxTaskbarMode' 'REG_DWORD' 0 RegSet $ADV 'Hidden' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet "$ADV\TaskbarDeveloperSettings" 'TaskbarEndTask' 'REG_DWORD' 1 # Icones pequenos na area de trabalho RegSet 'HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\Bags\1\Desktop' 'IconSize' 'REG_DWORD' 32 RegSet 'HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\Bags\1\Desktop' 'Mode' 'REG_DWORD' 1 RegSet 'HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\Bags\1\Desktop' 'LogicalViewMode' 'REG_DWORD' 3 # Barra de tarefas sem fixados (reforco) & reg.exe delete 'HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Taskband' /f 2>$null | Out-Null Remove-Item "$env:APPDATA\Microsoft\Internet Explorer\Quick Launch\User Pinned\TaskBar\*" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# Visual C++, .NET 3.5 e Notepad++ em segundo plano (nao trava a area de trabalho) Start-Process powershell.exe -WindowStyle Hidden -ArgumentList '-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\Apps.ps1"'
Stop-Process -Name explorer -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Write-Host 'Pronto. Reinicie o PC uma vez.' Stop-Transcript | Out-Null

# Limpeza-SSD.ps1 - rode (como admin) depois de instalar atualizacoes/drivers. # Libera varios GB no C:. Demora de 5 a 20 minutos. # Aviso: /ResetBase impede desinstalar as atualizacoes ja instaladas. & dism.exe /Online /Cleanup-Image /StartComponentCleanup /ResetBase Remove-Item "$env:SystemRoot\SoftwareDistribution\Download\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Remove-Item "$env:TEMP\*", "$env:SystemRoot\Temp\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue & cleanmgr.exe /verylowdisk $livre = [math]::Round((Get-PSDrive C).Free / 1GB, 1) Write-Host "Espaco livre no C: $livre GB"
